children: Iron ore is lower in Asian trade, with the most actively traded January iron ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange down 0.5% at 733.5 yuan a ton. Iron ore is weighed by expectations of weaker fundamentals despite some near-term support from steel mills' preholiday restocking, Baocheng Futures analysts write in a note. Demand has stabilized at lower levels, while steelmakers have stepped up purchases ahead of China's National Day holiday, offering some support for prices, they say. However, losses at mills raise concerns about production cuts and a potential negative feedback loop for steel and iron ore demand, they add. (jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
